title: AION 2 Gladiator: Starter Build and Tanking
description: Build an AION 2 Gladiator around useful passives, MP management and reachable defenses. Adapt a sourced early-game example for solo play or party tanking.
summary: Start with sustainable melee damage, select your unlocked skill options, and equip protection when your party asks you to tank.
quickAnswer: Gladiator is a frontline melee fighter. Begin with a repeatable attack loop and reachable defensive skills; the starter build here is a live-server simulation of early Global progression, so check each skill option before copying it.
